title: Jobbing with Jack Carey, Kid Rene, Chris Kelly and Kid Thomas
summary: After Kendrick he played a four-dollar job with Jack Carey, then with Kid Rene, Chris Kelly at the halls, and Kid Thomas's band across the river.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Well, then I finished playing with Gerald Kendrick, well, then I started playing with other groups. Well, and those years ago I even played with Jack Carey at Brown's Velvet Ice Cream Place. And I made four dollars that night. Gee, I thought I made big money.
What was that, the advertised for the ice cream or what?
No, he was playing for a dance like, a party like, inside of Brown's Velvet Plant on Brown's Street. He was playing for a dance, a party there had put on.

Then I played with Kid René years ago. I played with John Lewis, played with John Lewis, a ticket seat. So Kid René got me to play with him. Well, I played a few jobs with Chris Kelly. Yeah, I played a few jobs at the Corborator Hall, the Economy Hall. Yeah, I played with them old guys. And I really enjoyed playing with them. I got a lot of experience, you see. And Kid Thomas, he came from over the river once and played back on St. Peter's Street, it was like a lumber yard but they cleaned it up and made a dance place out of it. Well I went over there and played with him, the Kid Thomas band. Well he was hot stuff then. Every time I was surprised they'd say, Kid Thomas coming over. He had about the best band here. Yeah, he still got a good band. Yeah, he still got a pretty good band, yeah. Kid Thomas was good. And I played with him over the river quite a few times, yes. And, well anyhow.
